positions.title: Senior Software Engineer III
positions.description: Brewing some secret potions at Nike...

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Privacy and Compliance Engineering (PACE) provides a set of APIs and Services that enforce GDPR and DPA compliance in Nike experiences. The User Permissions Service (PACE-UPS) empowers Nike users with the ability to accept or decline Nike's usage of their personal data.

As a Senior Software Engineer III:
• I maintain the same technical responsibilities as a Senior Software Engineer II
• I participate in stakeholder meetings and coordinate efforts across different spaces.
• I evangelize technologies and design patterns within the UPS team to adopt new tools and practices.
• Write general tutorials aimed for high visibility and reusability within PACE.
• Facilitate 1:1s to ensure coworkers have a safe place to provide and receive feedback.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• successfully lead the China for China (C4C) initiative for the UPS + GSPAN (contractor) teams to stand up the User Permissions Service up in the Greater China region
• assist the User Permission Service (UPS) team create REST apis that empower users to accept or decline Nike's use of consumer data according to GDPR
• assist the team to design and create serverless REST apis using AWS technologies such as API Gateway, lambda, DynamoDb, etc.
• assist the team to design and create serverless auditing and data lake downstream systems to maintain compliance with GDPR and send consent information to internal Nike services by using AWS technologies such as lambda, SQS, SNS, etc.
• assist the team to design and create a system that delivers localized static content to Nike apps. The static content contains localized (translated) words and legal documents for Nike apps to display to the user. 
• hold technology learning sessions and write Confluence blogs about JavaScript, TypeScript, NodeJs, Visual Studio Code, etc. to spread knowledge throughout the PACE organization
• observe and heal service instabilities as a bugmaster using monitoring and observability tools such as AWS CloudWatch Insights, Splunk, SignalFx, etc.
• heavily involved in the hiring process for Senior and lead level engineers. I have created most of the resources related to the hiring process for PACE such as guidlines, technical questions, behavioral questions, rubrics, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Division: Technology Office (TO)
Team: License and Business Intelligence Tools
Projects: Licensing, Analytics

- RESTful development with Java and Spring
- TDD development using NodeJs, Sinon, Mocha, etc.
- Automated deployment with GitLab CI, CloudFormation and AWS Lambda
- Mock server development pure Express and core Node Modules
- Autogenerated java documentation and developer testing ui for REST endpoints
- NodeJs Testing Framework for micro services deployed, live on AWS
- AWS CloudWatch + AWS Lambda logging
- Secure, internal SPA company website using React, React Router, Unstated, NodeJs, Bootstrap 4, Docker and NGINX that autogenerates resources for developers
- Secure, internal SPA company website using React, React Router, Unstated, NodeJs, Materialize CSS, Docker and NGINX that allows authenticated users to read resources

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Strategic Student Program Software Engineering Intern Qualities:
• XML Unmarshalling using Simple API for XML (SAX) Parsing and Java Reflection.
• Understand Service-Oriented Architecture Framework, Logic and Design.
• Service-Oriented Architecture Framework API Development.
• XML Marshalling and Unmarshalling using Document Object Model (DOM) and Java Reflection.
• Develop and support Teamcenter software solutions using Java, web technologies, Eclipse, and C++.
• Small enhancement requests/usability improvements.
• Execute test for quality and performance.
• Functionality test execution (Unit Testing) using JUnit and documentation.
• Performance, Scalability, and System Testing.

positions.title: Inventory Processor
positions.description:
The ideal Inventory Processor is independent, flexible, motivated, results oriented and committed to providing outstanding customer experiences every day that drive sales.

Responsibilities:
• Demonstrate initiative in accomplishing tasks and meeting quality standards
• Unpack, sort and stock newly arrived merchandise
• Ensure all merchandise is accurately ticketed, accounted for and processed
• Accurate and efficient use of mobile and hand held devices
• Fulfill customer orders from store inventory in a timely manner with a high fulfillment percent and sense of urgency
• Assist in maintaining clean and organized selling floors and stockrooms

honors.title: The 2016 Spring ACM On-Campus Programming Competition
honors.description:
Placement: 1st
Team Name: YouGotHacked
Approximate Turnout: 10 teams

Teams of 3 students solve as many problems within a specified time limit. Placement is determined by the number of problems solved, time to submit each solution and the least amount of mistakes made.
honors.issuer: Issued by Association for Computing Machinery · Apr 2016

honors.title: The 2015 Southern California Regionals Contest
honors.description:
Placement: 28
Team Name: You Got Hacked
Approximate Turnout: 89 teams
Standing: http://socalcontest.org/history/2015/details-2015.shtml

The ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) is a multitier, team-based, programming competition operating under the auspices of ACM and headquartered at Baylor University. The contest involves a global network of universities hosting regional competitions that advance teams to the ACM-ICPC World Finals. Participation has grown to several tens of thousands of the finest students and faculty in computing disciplines at over 2,500 universities from over 100 countries on six continents.
honors.issuer: Issued by ACM Association of Computing Machinery · Nov 2015

projects.title: B3Trace
projects.description: This NPM module provides an Object representation of a B3 TraceContext based on the OpenZipkin specifications. B3Trace lets you construct new Traces or a TraceContext from a parent TraceContext.

projects.title: Context Store
projects.description: ContextStore (ctxstore) is a context decorator library designed for nodejs that synchronizes contexts within a call stack.
